## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Cline #13549: API key sanitization + provider auth error classification — prevent clipboard corruption + actionable auth failures (HIGH ~6h combined)

- **What**: (1) Strip control characters (`\p{Cc}`), formatting characters (`\p{Cf}`), and surrounding whitespace from pasted API keys at the provider config store write boundary. Whitespace-only value clears the key. Prevents invisible clipboard artifacts (newlines, zero-width spaces, BOM) from causing 401s indistinguishable from genuinely wrong keys. (2) Classify HTTP 401/403 as `ProviderErrorClass: 'auth'` (status-only, since provider bodies can quote "unauthorized" without being auth failures). Rewrite classified BYOK provider credential rejections into actionable text pointing at API key configuration, keeping provider's raw body as diagnostic tail. Cline-account providers keep JSON path for webview sign-in card.
- **Why**: API keys smuggle control/invisible characters from clipboards; masked key fields hide corruption and providers reject with 401s that look like wrong keys. Mistral returns identical `{"detail":"Invalid API Key"}` for wrong, empty, or wrong-scope key — raw JSON is a dead end. Actionable guidance (e.g. "Check API key in Settings > Providers > Mistral") is better UX.
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13549 (fix: sanitize stored API keys and make provider credential rejections actionable)
- **Category**: provider + config
- **Size**: HIGH (~6h — Alexi stores API keys as-is (no sanitization check needed), has error handling (`src/core/errors.ts`, `src/core/error-backoff.ts`) but no auth-specific `ProviderErrorClass`. Implement both: (1) add sanitize function at config write boundary (`src/config/` or `src/providers/auth.ts`) — regex strip `\p{Cc}`, `\p{Cf}`, trim whitespace, clear on whitespace-only; (2) extend `ProviderErrorClass` with `'auth'` for HTTP 401/403 (`src/core/errors.ts`), thread through error handling, rewrite auth errors in user-facing surfaces (`src/cli/interactive.ts`, `src/cli/tui/`) into actionable guidance instead of raw provider JSON. High value for BYOK users).

#### 2. Cline #13677: Abort propagation to delegated subagents — stop parent stops child (HIGH ~6h)

- **What**: Parent `AbortSignal` now propagates to delegated subagent `SessionRuntime`. Signal observed only during active run (scoped listeners). Retains abort received during startup. Releases delegated sessions after execution. Inherits parent runtime PID for subagents.
- **Why**: Stopping parent task now actually stops child agents. Prevents runaway subagents consuming resources when parent is cancelled.
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13677 (fix(core): propagate parent aborts to delegated subagents)
- **Category**: tool
- **Size**: HIGH (~6h — Alexi has agent-manager abort (`src/core/agent-manager/`), unclear if `spawn_agent` delegations inherit parent signal. Audit abort propagation in `src/core/orchestrator.ts`, `src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts`, `src/tool/tools/task.ts` for subagent delegation paths. If parent `AbortSignal` is not threaded to child agents, implement: (1) pass parent `signal` to `SessionRuntime` constructor for delegated agents, (2) observe signal only during active run (add/remove listeners in run lifecycle), (3) release delegated sessions after execution, (4) inherit parent runtime PID. Critical for task control).

#### 3. Cline #13583: Empty capability list handling — fail-open for unspecified capabilities (MODERATE ~3h)

- **What**: `modelHasCapability` documents missing or empty `[]` capability list as carrying no signal (each gate declares fail-open default). Two readers bypassed it and read `capabilities` directly, where `[].includes(x)` is `false` not nullish: (1) session runtime's `modelSupportsImages` used `capabilities?.includes('images') ?? true`, so empty list never hit nullish-coalescing and file-read tool silently dropped images; (2) `toProviderModel` projected `[]` onto `false`, telling pickers model definitively lacks vision/attachments/reasoning when nothing declared. Both now route through `modelSupportsImageInput` / `declaredCapability` helpers. Thinking config short-circuits `supportsReasoning` instead of OR-ing with capability read, so absence no longer collapses tri-state to `false`.
- **Why**: Empty capability list should be treated as "unspecified" (fail-open) not "definitively lacks X" (authoritative denial). Prevents tools from silently dropping features when catalog metadata is incomplete.
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13583 (fix(core): stop an empty capability list from stripping image input)
- **Category**: provider
- **Size**: MODERATE (~3h — Alexi has model capabilities (`src/providers/model-match.ts`, `src/providers/modelCatalog.ts`). Audit capability readers for same bug: search for `capabilities?.includes(` or direct `capabilities` reads. Add helper `modelSupportsImageInput` / `declaredCapability` if missing, route readers through helpers with explicit fail-open default for empty/missing list. Check `src/tool/tools/read.ts` (image handling), `src/providers/format.ts` (request building) for capability checks. Bug fix).

#### 4. Cline #12673: User rejection tool messaging — standardize rejection reasons (MODERATE ~4h)

- **What**: Standardized tool rejection messages with `buildUserRejectedToolReason` constant builder in `@cline/shared`. Adds guidance suffix clarifying rejection is NOT system error (e.g. "—— The user's rejection is not evidence you did something wrong. Consider waiting for further guidance before trying again."). Routes all approval surfaces (CLI connectors, ACP permissions, Cline Hub webview, desktop webview, example extension) through shared reason builder. Moved rejection guidance suffix into agent runtime per review.
- **Why**: Prevents LLM from treating user rejection as system error/failure. Improves retry behavior (model doesn't spiral into apologetic loops). Consistent messaging across all denial surfaces.
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/12673 (Clarify model-facing message when user rejects a tool call)
- **Category**: tool
- **Size**: MODERATE (~4h — Alexi uses ad-hoc denial messages (`Permission denied`, `User rejected`, `Tool approval denied`) without shared constant. Create `buildUserRejectedToolReason(toolName: string, reason?: string): string` helper in `src/permission/index.ts` or `src/tool/index.ts`, add guidance suffix (e.g. `— The user's rejection is not evidence you did something wrong.`). Update ~10 rejection sites: permission manager (`src/permission/index.ts`), tool approval flows (`src/cli/interactive.ts`, `src/cli/tui/`), MCP tool denials (`src/mcp/`). Improves LLM behavior on rejections).

#### 5. Cline #13719: CLI markdown streaming prop stability — stop settle flash (MODERATE ~3h)

- **What**: Flipping markdown `<markdown>` component's `streaming` prop from `true` to `false` when assistant text segment settles makes `MarkdownRenderable` call `updateBlocks(true)`, which skips every block-reuse path and destroys and recreates all block renderables. Until tree-sitter re-highlights them the whole message renders blank/unhighlighted, which users see as text flashing at end of each response. Keep `streaming={true}` for transcript markdown (opencode's TUI does same); `entry.streaming` still drives spinner glyph.
- **Why**: Eliminates visual flashing at end of responses in CLI TUI. Better UX.
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13719 (fix(cli): keep markdown streaming prop stable to stop settle flash)
- **Category**: command
- **Size**: MODERATE (~3h — Alexi TUI uses Ink + marked + marked-terminal (`src/cli/tui/`, `src/cli/interactive.ts`). Verify if same flash occurs: check if markdown component has `streaming` prop that toggles on message settle, if tree-sitter or marked blocks are destroyed/recreated. If flash exists, apply fix: keep `streaming={true}` stable, drive spinner visibility from `entry.streaming` separately. 1-line fix if issue reproduces, but verification + testing takes time).
